svg.title: Hazel Hidayah animated profile banner for light mode
svg.desc: An editorial animated banner introducing Hazel as a coder, designer, and storyteller.

g.text: I'm a Computer Science student at NUS. I used to study Mass Communication at Ngee Ann Polytechnic,
so most of my time now has been dedicated to beating imposter syndrome! I find anything design &
computer related fascinating so I dedicate my life to learning everything I can and nerding out about it :)
